name: @avatark/world-experience-contracts
description: Renderer-neutral contracts for Build 04's World Experience layer: Arrival policy (first-ever/returning/stale/canon-directed/safe-fallback), a declarative Experience Graph (visitor-experience stage vocabulary and allowed transitions -- descriptive, never a gate on the autonomous simulation), Place Continuity (what a place exposes to a visitor, derived from existing runtime truth, never a second world-state store), Orientation (world-awareness Q&A: where am I / what is around me / what is happening / where can I go / what has changed), and the World Experience Snapshot Unreal-handoff aggregate. No implementations, no new persisted state -- every field here is either a pure derivation input/output shape or a re-export of an existing contract shape (world-embodiment/spatial-ecology/canonical-event/world-memory/living-rhythms), never a duplicate world-state authority.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json --outDir dist --declaration --noEmit false --rewriteRelativeImportExtensions --module esnext --moduleResolution bundler && node ../../scripts/fix-dts-extensions.mjs dist
